paragraphs.source_en: taken.” Javert replied in his most imperious tone:— “Why not at once?” “We are saving our powder.” “Then finish the business with a blow from a knife.” “Spy,” said the handsome Enjolras, “we are judges and not assassins.” Then he called Gavroche:— “Here you! go about your business! Do what I told you!” “I’m going!” cried Gavroche. And halting as he was on the point of setting out:— “By the way, you will give me his gun!” and he added: “I leave you the musician, but I want the clarinet.” The gamin made the military salute and passed gayly through the opening in the large barricade.
